claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission at 6:35 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launch was successful.
The Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The launch vehicle for the Artemis II mission is Space Launch System (SLS).
The launch site for the Artemis II mission is Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center.
The SLS rocket for the Artemis II mission was crewed.
The Artemis II mission lifted off on a 10-day journey around the moon.
The Artemis II mission marks the first human mission to the lunar vicinity in over 50 years.
The crew of the Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The mission goal of the Artemis II mission is a 10-day flight around the Moon and back.
The initial target time for the Artemis II mission was 6:24 p.m. ET.
The target time for the Artemis II mission was adjusted slightly to 6:35 p.m. ET.
